title: [29.X]-Subscription Billing: Recurring Billing (Document Per = Contract Partner) Overwrites Contract Currency with Customer Currency Without Amount Conversion.653480 initial commit
summary: Fixes recurring billing in Subscription Billing with Document Per = Contract Partner. Billing documents replaced the contract currency with the customer's currency without converting the amounts. The change is in codeunit Create Billing Documents.
key_points: Fixes billing document creation when Document Per is set to Contract Partner
Before the fix, the contract currency was replaced by the customer currency and the amounts were not converted
Small change in codeunit 8060 Create Billing Documents
Adds a test in Recurring Billing Docs Test for this scenario
